items.title: Pfizer’s CEO Wants AI to “Halve the Time to First Human Study.” Here’s What That Means for Its Pipeline
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPfizer CEO Albert Bourla wants AI to cut the time to a drug’s first human study from four years to two, then halve the time from there to approval. Faster lab work pays off in the 2030s, since nothing Pfizer starts now reaches human trials before generic Eliquis arrives in 2028.

items.title: Eli Lilly (LLY) Acquires Huntington's Disease Drug Developer
items.summary: Eli Lilly (NYSE: LLY) agreed to acquire UK based LoQus23 Therapeutics to advance an oral therapy for Huntington's disease. The deal gives Lilly access to LoQus23's targeted small molecule program that aims to address underlying drivers of Huntington's disease. The acquisition broadens Eli Lilly's neuroscience research footprint beyond its existing cardiometabolic and oncology focus areas.
